objectives: Publish only recurrent States materialized from the verified parent and authoritative returned token IDs, independently of the sampler's live row
Preserve one semantic sample, unchanged raw output and exact receipt replay; expose deterministic cache materialization separately
Reject malformed token evidence before all state transitions; never adjust counts to hide an inexact numerical boundary
Use the canonical State profile loader in Native and Selector
Preserve Supervisor stream evidence before protocol validation without relaxing the parser
required_validation: Red then green regression for sampler States at, ahead of and behind the returned stop boundary
Repeated generation, commit, append, rollback, durable restart and request replay
Materialization failure publishes no candidate and never resamples an unknown request
Canonical State profile identity, shape and transpose tests
Full tests suite with no skips
Live stop-string generation, retry input and exported numerical State equality with deterministic prefix materialization
collection_policy: Fresh source freeze for later production collection; previous completed runs remain sealed and are not rescored
training_authorization: Existing owner stagewise authorization persists; no optimizer until current-role registered data and evaluation are ready
